language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially rests on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its gripper around the handle and lifts the spoon (frames 82–123, image, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then carries it over the open drawer (frames 164–175, image and wrist_image). It releases the spoon into the drawer at frames 176–181; the spoon is visibly resting inside with the gripper clear at frames 183–188 (image and wrist_image), and remains in the drawer through frame 210 (image). No failed acquisition, unintended object disturbance or other local failure is established.
